description: R&D cycle: brief → scan (local) → 2 analysts (local) → R&D Manager calibration (Opus) → owner decision.

stages.task: Fill docs/research/brief-template.md into docs/research/cycles/{{date}}/brief.md. Theme: {{theme}}. Read docs/research/backlog.md so covered ideas are skipped.

Run the scan for the R&D cycle in docs/research/cycles/{{date}}/brief.md, following your role file and docs/research/METHODOLOGY.md. Write docs/research/cycles/{{date}}/scan.md. End scan.md with a line 'ANALYZE: slug1, slug2, ...' listing the ~6 ideas for analysis.
stages.note: Web research needs WebSearch, an Anthropic server tool: unavailable on local models (ADR 0001). Analysts stay local and use WebFetch only if needed.

stages.task: Analyze the FIRST HALF of the ideas on the 'ANALYZE:' line at the end of docs/research/cycles/{{date}}/scan.md. Write one docs/research/ideas/<slug>.md per idea, per your role file.
Analyze the SECOND HALF of the ideas on the 'ANALYZE:' line at the end of docs/research/cycles/{{date}}/scan.md. Write one docs/research/ideas/<slug>.md per idea, per your role file.
Mode B for the cycle in docs/research/cycles/{{date}}/: calibrate, rank, write proposal.md with the Owner decision block, update docs/research/backlog.md.

stages.title: R&D proposal {{date}}: pick what to build
